card: Adds a unit test in denialofservice_tests verifying that orphan transaction reconsideration in PeerManager yields after accepting or rejecting at most one orphan per ProcessMessages call. This provides regression coverage for the orphan denial-of-service vulnerability disclosed in CVE-2024-52914 and kills two mutants in net_processing where early returns were deleted.
changed_since_previous: The PR diff is functionally equivalent, continuing to add the unit test covering interruptible orphan reconsideration.
evidence: Author description states this test prevents regression of CVE-2024-52914, which currently has no test coverage in the repository.
Author demonstrates that the test kills two specific mutants in `src/net_processing.cpp` where `return true` is removed after an orphan is accepted or rejected.
problem: CVE-2024-52914 allowed peers to stall message processing by triggering unbounded orphan processing. While the production code was fixed to yield after each orphan reconsideration, the test suite did not verify this interruptibility, leaving the behavior vulnerable to silent regressions.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests with no changes to production node logic.

summary: Adds a unit test in `denialofservice_tests.cpp` to verify that `PeerManagerImpl::ProcessOrphanTx` reconsiders at most one orphan transaction per `ProcessMessages()` cycle. It confirms that both valid and invalid reconsidered orphans cause message processing to yield after handling a single orphan.
